descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P2 · extra (accessibility, performance, prototype detail) · ours: accessibility (axe, names, tap size).

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S24 Post-Round screens and the Pending Tasks sheet pass axe and the phone checks (desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 WebKit)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 2; TFA-92595 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U4 With pending tasks, 'Mark Encounter Complete' opens the Pending Tasks prompt with three choices, and each works: Delete & complete deletes the pending tasks and completes; … (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 8; TFA-92595 How it works 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T4 'Mark Encounter Complete' is present and functional from all three toggles (Note, Tasks, Meds), not just Note. (TFA-92595 AC 7; TFA-92595 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given A seeded Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident in note-ready with a note, open tasks and tracker rows

When The visual lane opens Post-Round on each toggle, the open Pending Tasks sheet and the open Ask sheet, in both contexts, on the three profiles

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violation; every control has an accessible name (task complete/delete icons, sheet close); the selected toggle exposes its state; the dialog has a name; no sideways scroll; tap targets ≥24 px (44 pt on iPhone)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core: 0 serious/critical; visual-lane overflow/tap/covered findings as evidence for a human (visual-checks.ts)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

Detail:

pr-tc17-s24-a11y.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 on WebKit (ran), both contexts, 30 screens. Not in UAT/ticket: QA-improvement findings only. Every screen: axe color-contrast (serious). NH: back button, task complete/delete icons unnamed (button-name), note/tasks/meds toggles expose no aria-pressed (Hospital does). Ask sheet (both): no dialog role, close X unnamed. Pending Tasks sheet is a named dialog. Small (<24 px) tap targets on every screen (icon buttons). No sideways scroll anywhere.

Evidence: 1 attached.
